id: title:charlesvien:send host theme to built canvas artifacts

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application user experience and visual consistency
review.reason: Adds theme support and live updates to the desktop canvas, including a theme store and theme-dependent URL, with the observed hunk P1.F2.H5 showing the application of the current theme. This improves the desktop user experience by allowing dynamic theme switching and avoiding visual inconsistencies, though no backend or shared infrastructure changes are observed.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is localized to the desktop client; no shared dependency or systemic change is demonstrated. The score is conservative, not a tier 2 or 3, and does not account for unverified adoption or broader ecosystem impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are made. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds theme support to BuiltCanvas, including a theme store, theme-dependent URL, and live theme updates.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the desktop canvas to receive and apply a theme, avoiding a white flash before styles load.
